option.name: --all
tip: Show all compiler options.

option.name: --allowArbitraryExtensions
tip: Enable importing files with any extension, provided a declaration file is present.

option.name: --allowImportingTsExtensions
tip: Allow imports to include TypeScript file extensions. Requires '--moduleResolution bundler' and either '--noEmit' or '--emitDeclarationOnly' to be set.

option.name: --allowJs
tip: Allow JavaScript files to be a part of your program. Use the 'checkJs' option to get errors from these files.

option.name: --allowSyntheticDefaultImports
tip: Allow 'import x from y' when a module doesn't have a default export.

option.name: --allowUmdGlobalAccess
tip: Allow accessing UMD globals from modules.

option.name: --allowUnreachableCode
tip: Disable error reporting for unreachable code.

option.name: --allowUnusedLabels
tip: Disable error reporting for unused labels.

option.name: --alwaysStrict
tip: Ensure 'use strict' is always emitted.

option.name: --assumeChangesOnlyAffectDirectDependencies
tip: Have recompiles in projects that use 'incremental' and 'watch' mode assume that changes within a file will only affect files directly depending on it.

option.name: --baseUrl
tip: Specify the base directory to resolve non-relative module names.

option.name: --build
tip: Build one or more projects and their dependencies, if out of date.

option.name: --builders
tip: Set the number of projects to build concurrently.

option.name: --checkers
tip: Set the number of checkers per project.

option.name: --checkJs
tip: Enable error reporting in type-checked JavaScript files.

option.name: --clean
tip: Delete the outputs of all projects.

option.name: --composite
tip: Enable constraints that allow a TypeScript project to be used with project references.

option.name: --customConditions
tip: Conditions to set in addition to the resolver-specific defaults when resolving imports.

option.name: --declaration
tip: Generate .d.ts files from TypeScript and JavaScript files in your project.

option.name: --declarationDir
tip: Specify the output directory for generated declaration files.

option.name: --declarationMap
tip: Create sourcemaps for d.ts files.

option.name: --deduplicatePackages
tip: Deduplicate packages with the same name and version.

option.name: --diagnostics
tip: Output compiler performance information after building.

option.name: --disableReferencedProjectLoad
tip: Reduce the number of projects loaded automatically by TypeScript.

option.name: --disableSizeLimit
tip: Remove the 20mb cap on total source code size for JavaScript files in the TypeScript language server.

option.name: --disableSolutionSearching
tip: Opt a project out of multi-project reference checking when editing.

option.name: --disableSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirect
tip: Disable preferring source files instead of declaration files when referencing composite projects.

option.name: --downlevelIteration
tip: Emit more compliant, but verbose and less performant JavaScript for iteration.

option.name: --dry
tip: Show what would be built (or deleted, if specified with '--clean').

option.name: --emitBOM
tip: Emit a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) in the beginning of output files.

option.name: --emitDeclarationOnly
tip: Only output d.ts files and not JavaScript files.

option.name: --emitDecoratorMetadata
tip: Emit design-type metadata for decorated declarations in source files.

option.name: --erasableSyntaxOnly
tip: Do not allow runtime constructs that are not part of ECMAScript.

option.name: --esModuleInterop
tip: Emit additional JavaScript to ease support for importing CommonJS modules. This enables 'allowSyntheticDefaultImports' for type compatibility.

option.name: --exactOptionalPropertyTypes
tip: Interpret optional property types as written, rather than adding 'undefined'.

option.name: --excludeDirectories
tip: Remove a list of directories from the watch process.

option.name: --excludeFiles
tip: Remove a list of files from the watch mode's processing.

option.name: --experimentalDecorators
tip: Enable experimental support for legacy experimental decorators.

option.name: --explainFiles
tip: Print files read during the compilation including why it was included.

option.name: --extendedDiagnostics
tip: Output more detailed compiler performance information after building.

option.name: --fallbackPolling
tip: Specify what approach the watcher should use if the system runs out of native file watchers.

option.name: --force
tip: Build all projects, including those that appear to be up to date.

option.name: --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames
tip: Ensure that casing is correct in imports.

option.name: --generateCpuProfile
tip: Emit a v8 CPU profile of the compiler run for debugging.

option.name: --generateTrace
tip: Generates an event trace and a list of types.

option.name: --ignoreConfig
tip: Ignore the tsconfig found and build with commandline options and files.

option.name: --importHelpers
tip: Allow importing helper functions from tslib once per project, instead of including them per-file.

option.name: --incremental
tip: Save .tsbuildinfo files to allow for incremental compilation of projects.

option.name: --init
tip: Initialize a TypeScript project and create a tsconfig.json file.

option.name: --inlineSourceMap
tip: Include sourcemap files inside the emitted JavaScript.

option.name: --inlineSources
tip: Include source code in the sourcemaps inside the emitted JavaScript.

option.name: --isolatedDeclarations
tip: Require sufficient annotation on exports so other tools can trivially generate declaration files.

option.name: --isolatedModules
tip: Ensure that each file can be safely transpiled without relying on other imports.

option.name: --jsx
tip: Specify what JSX code is generated.

option.name: --jsxFactory
tip: Specify the JSX factory function used when targeting React JSX emit, e.g. 'React.createElement' or 'h'.

option.name: --jsxFragmentFactory
tip: Specify the JSX Fragment reference used for fragments when targeting React JSX emit e.g. 'React.Fragment' or 'Fragment'.

option.name: --jsxImportSource
tip: Specify module specifier used to import the JSX factory functions when using 'jsx: react-jsx*'.

option.name: --lib
tip: Specify a set of bundled library declaration files that describe the target runtime environment.

option.name: --libReplacement
tip: Enable lib replacement.

option.name: --listEmittedFiles
tip: Print the names of emitted files after a compilation.

option.name: --listFiles
tip: Print all of the files read during the compilation.

option.name: --listFilesOnly
tip: Print names of files that are part of the compilation and then stop processing.

option.name: --locale
tip: Set the language of the messaging from TypeScript. This does not affect emit.

option.name: --mapRoot
tip: Specify the location where debugger should locate map files instead of generated locations.

option.name: --maxNodeModuleJsDepth
tip: Specify the maximum folder depth used for checking JavaScript files from 'node_modules'. Only applicable with 'allowJs'.

option.name: --module
tip: Specify what module code is generated.

option.name: --moduleDetection
tip: Control what method is used to detect module-format JS files.

option.name: --moduleResolution
tip: Specify how TypeScript looks up a file from a given module specifier.

option.name: --moduleSuffixes
tip: List of file name suffixes to search when resolving a module.

option.name: --newLine
tip: Set the newline character for emitting files.

option.name: --noCheck
tip: Disable full type checking (only critical parse and emit errors will be reported).

option.name: --noEmit
tip: Disable emitting files from a compilation.

option.name: --noEmitHelpers
tip: Disable generating custom helper functions like '__extends' in compiled output.

option.name: --noEmitOnError
tip: Disable emitting files if any type checking errors are reported.

option.name: --noErrorTruncation
tip: Disable truncating types in error messages.

option.name: --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch
tip: Enable error reporting for fallthrough cases in switch statements.

option.name: --noImplicitAny
tip: Enable error reporting for expressions and declarations with an implied 'any' type.

option.name: --noImplicitOverride
tip: Ensure overriding members in derived classes are marked with an override modifier.

option.name: --noImplicitReturns
tip: Enable error reporting for codepaths that do not explicitly return in a function.

option.name: --noImplicitThis
tip: Enable error reporting when 'this' is given the type 'any'.

option.name: --noLib
tip: Disable including any library files, including the default lib.d.ts.

option.name: --noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature
tip: Enforces using indexed accessors for keys declared using an indexed type.

option.name: --noResolve
tip: Disallow 'import's, 'require's or '<reference>'s from expanding the number of files TypeScript should add to a project.

option.name: --noUncheckedIndexedAccess
tip: Add 'undefined' to a type when accessed using an index.

option.name: --noUncheckedSideEffectImports
tip: Check side effect imports.

option.name: --noUnusedLocals
tip: Enable error reporting when local variables aren't read.

option.name: --noUnusedParameters
tip: Raise an error when a function parameter isn't read.

option.name: --outDir
tip: Specify an output folder for all emitted files.

option.name: --outFile
tip: Specify a file that bundles all outputs into one JavaScript file. If 'declaration' is true, also designates a file that bundles all .d.ts output.

option.name: --paths
tip: Specify a set of entries that re-map imports to additional lookup locations.

option.name: --plugins
tip: Specify a list of language service plugins to include.

option.name: --pprofDir
tip: Generate pprof CPU/memory profiles to the given directory.

option.name: --preserveConstEnums
tip: Disable erasing 'const enum' declarations in generated code.

option.name: --preserveSymlinks
tip: Disable resolving symlinks to their realpath. This correlates to the same flag in node.

option.name: --preserveWatchOutput
tip: Disable wiping the console in watch mode.

option.name: --pretty
tip: Enable color and formatting in TypeScript's output to make compiler errors easier to read.

option.name: --project
tip: Compile the project given the path to its configuration file, or to a folder with a 'tsconfig.json'.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not print diagnostics.

option.name: --reactNamespace
tip: Specify the object invoked for 'createElement'. This only applies when targeting 'react' JSX emit.

option.name: --removeComments
tip: Disable emitting comments.

option.name: --resolveJsonModule
tip: Enable importing .json files.

option.name: --resolvePackageJsonExports
tip: Use the package.json 'exports' field when resolving package imports.

option.name: --resolvePackageJsonImports
tip: Use the package.json 'imports' field when resolving imports.

option.name: --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions
tip: Rewrite '.ts', '.tsx', '.mts', and '.cts' file extensions in relative import paths to their JavaScript equivalent in output files.

option.name: --rootDir
tip: Specify the root folder within your source files.

option.name: --rootDirs
tip: Allow multiple folders to be treated as one when resolving modules.

option.name: --showConfig
tip: Print the final configuration instead of building.

option.name: --singleThreaded
tip: Run in single threaded mode.

option.name: --skipDefaultLibCheck
tip: Skip type checking .d.ts files that are included with TypeScript.

option.name: --skipLibCheck
tip: Skip type checking all .d.ts files.

option.name: --sourceMap
tip: Create source map files for emitted JavaScript files.

option.name: --sourceRoot
tip: Specify the root path for debuggers to find the reference source code.

option.name: --stableTypeOrdering
tip: Ensure types are ordered stably and deterministically across compilations.

option.name: --stopBuildOnErrors
tip: Skip building downstream projects on error in upstream project.

option.name: --strict
tip: Enable all strict type-checking options.

option.name: --strictBindCallApply
tip: Check that the arguments for 'bind', 'call', and 'apply' methods match the original function.

option.name: --strictBuiltinIteratorReturn
tip: Built-in iterators are instantiated with a 'TReturn' type of 'undefined' instead of 'any'.

option.name: --strictFunctionTypes
tip: When assigning functions, check to ensure parameters and the return values are subtype-compatible.

option.name: --strictNullChecks
tip: When type checking, take into account 'null' and 'undefined'.

option.name: --strictPropertyInitialization
tip: Check for class properties that are declared but not set in the constructor.

option.name: --stripInternal
tip: Disable emitting declarations that have '@internal' in their JSDoc comments.

option.name: --synchronousWatchDirectory
tip: Synchronously call callbacks and update the state of directory watchers on platforms that don't support recursive watching natively.

option.name: --target
tip: Set the JavaScript language version for emitted JavaScript and include compatible library declarations.

option.name: --traceResolution
tip: Log paths used during the 'moduleResolution' process.

option.name: --tsBuildInfoFile
tip: Specify the path to .tsbuildinfo incremental compilation file.

option.name: --typeRoots
tip: Specify multiple folders that act like './node_modules/@types'.

option.name: --types
tip: Specify type package names to be included without being referenced in a source file.

option.name: --useDefineForClassFields
tip: Emit ECMAScript-standard-compliant class fields.

option.name: --useUnknownInCatchVariables
tip: Default catch clause variables as 'unknown' instead of 'any'.

option.name: --verbatimModuleSyntax
tip: Do not transform or elide any imports or exports not marked as type-only, ensuring they are written in the output file's format based on the 'module' setting.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Enable verbose logging.

option.name: --version
tip: Print the compiler's version.

option.name: --watch
tip: Watch input files.

option.name: --watchDirectory
tip: Specify how directories are watched on systems that lack recursive file-watching functionality.

option.name: --watchFile
tip: Specify how the TypeScript watch mode works.

option.name: --watchInterval
tip: Specify the polling interval for watch mode in milliseconds.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print this message.
